quarterly_data.quarter: Synopsys press release: Synopsys and Amazon Announce Strategic, Multi-year IP (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Synopsys announced a strategic, multi-year, $1B+ agreement with Amazon that expands Amazon's use of Synopsys IP to include application-optimized silicon IP, with Amazon as the lead customer of this expansion of Synopsys' silicon IP business; the agreement evolves to a license-plus-royalty business model that aims to deliver value to both companies as production volumes grow. It also expands Amazon's use of Synopsys EDA, simulation and analysis (S&A) and agentic AI technologies for Amazon's custom chips (Nitro, Graviton, Trainium) and AWS infrastructure.

connects_to.relationship: silicon IP (including application-optimized IP), EDA, simulation and analysis and agentic AI tools for Amazon custom chips (Nitro, Graviton, Trainium)

contracts.source: Synopsys press release: Synopsys and Amazon Announce Strategic, Multi-year IP (09-30-2026)
contracts.signal: Strategic, multi-year IP agreement for Amazon custom silicon: building on more than 15 years of collaboration, it expands Amazon's use of Synopsys IP to application-optimized silicon IP (Amazon is the lead customer) under a license-plus-royalty model, and expands Amazon's use of Synopsys EDA, S&A and agentic AI technologies; the companies will work to accelerate multiphysics solutions on Trainium and Graviton and plan to develop custom agentic AI capabilities for Amazon's engineering teams. In the other direction, Synopsys is adopting Amazon EC2, cloud storage services and Amazon Bedrock for its own IP and EDA development. Amazon's Peter DeSantis: Synopsys 'helps us move faster across the design cycle'.
contracts.type: multi-year IP licence-plus-royalty agreement (plus EDA / S&A / agentic AI)
